source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    holes = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            color = grid[r][c - 1]
            if color != 0 and grid[r][c] == 0 and grid[r][c + 1] == color:
                holes.setdefault(c, []).append((r, color))
                out[r][c] = color
    for c, marks in holes.items():

                out[rr][c] = lower_color
    return out
'''
